meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器

copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 装上后，群组可以选择 OpenAI 的 Codex 作为智能体后端，由它负责规划、调用 MCP 工具、管理对话历史与恢复会话，可替代 Claude 或与它并用；切换需手动配置。
howto.when: 当你在主机上执行 `ncl groups config update --provider codex` 切换到某个群组并重启后，该群组的对话由 Codex 接管；若把默认 provider 设为 codex，新建群组也会自动使用它。

say.note: Codex 会从服务端续接历史

say.text: 用 MCP 工具查一下这个主题
say.note: Codex 会编排工具并返回结果

howto.what_en: After install, groups can select OpenAI's Codex as the agent backend instead of or alongside Claude. Codex handles planning, MCP tool orchestration, server-side conversation history, and session resume. Switching is a manual per-group configuration.
howto.when_en: When you run `ncl groups config update --provider codex` for a group and restart it, Codex starts handling that group's conversations. If the instance default is set to codex, newly created groups also use it automatically.

say_en.text: Look up this topic with MCP tools
say_en.note: Codex orchestrates tools and returns the result.
